definitions.explanation: The state of being innocent of a crime or accusation; having not committed the alleged offense.

examples.japanese: {無実|むじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：01447_shoumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誓|ちか}って→誓う：00030_chikau⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無実|むじつ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I swear to God, I am innocent.

notes:
{無実|むじつ} means innocence or being not guilty.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {無実|むじつ}の{罪|つみ}: false accusation, being wrongly accused
- {無実|むじつ}を{証明|しょうめい}する: to prove one's innocence
- {無実|むじつ}を{主張|しゅちょう}する: to claim innocence

CONTRAST:
- {無実|むじつ}: innocent (not guilty of crime)
- {無罪|むざい}: not guilty (legal verdict)
